title: Genistin: A Novel Estrogen Analogue Targeting ERβ to Alleviate Thrombocytopenia.
summary: Publisher full text/PDF Methods and Results show RF screening over 777 descriptors, followed by cell and mouse experiments on genistin; biological effects and ERβ-related mechanism are supported preclinically.
ai_technology: ML narrowed candidate search; genistin promoted megakaryocyte/platelet outcomes in vitro and improved radiation thrombocytopenia in mice. This is preclinical evidence, not clinical treatment efficacy.
